notes: All three documents and the film had mined moments, so no new document or video moments were needed; the three photos got new image moments. Every quote was found verbatim on its mined page (no neighbouring-page fallback) and every box was checked on a 200 dpi crop; boxes come from fresh OCR (ocr mode), because the auto/raw text layers of all three PDFs are badly scrambled. Acoustic Kitty p1: the redactions are blank white-outs with hand-drawn bars, not black bars, so the short cuts with … where the deleted text begins (“distances [deleted] we see no reason…”); the full mined quote (118 chars) was too long for short. Simple Sabotage p18: the short uses the second sentence (“never less than five”); the quote keeps the hyphen-broken “considera-tion” joined and uses curly quotes and a spaced em dash as printed. Pages 18 and 20 are two-page book spreads (landscape, aspect about 1.27), so the face is one column, about 36% of the spread width, with the usual 1.25 height ratio in pixels. Project 1794 p5: the typescript prints “100, 000” with a space after the comma; quote and lensText write 100,000. The face (60% of the page width) holds the whole second moment line, but the first moment line runs to 0.944 and is cut at the right edge. Camp Century: hosted video.mp4 (first 900 s) matches the source timing frame for frame; the plan shot starts between 410.5 and 411 s, the pointer is on REACTOR at 412-414 s, the cutaway dissolves in at about 415 s and the COMMUNICATION TRENCH label appears at about 424 s. Insectothopter square: 1056 px square holding the whole body, tail tip to head, plus wing roots; checked as a 120 px ball. No grief items in this topic. Skeptic pass (second agent): re-cropped every line, lens and face box at 200 dpi and checked quotes against the page images; quotes, shorts, lensTexts, line boxes, order and lead all hold. Changes: Acoustic Kitty face widened to 0.115-0.765 (65% of the page width, slightly over the 60% guide) and moved up to start at MEMORANDUM FOR, because the old box cut 'believe' at the right edge and a sliver of the RELEASED stamp at the bottom; Project 1794 face moved up 0.008 so its top line is whole instead of a cut sliver; Simple Sabotage p20 lens widened to 0.335 so the box does not clip the 'y' of 'hysterically'; Pigeon square moved to 1200 px (210-1410 x 260-1460 px) so the camera and the beak both sit inside the inscribed circle of a ball (the old square clipped the camera's lower-left corner in a circle); Camp Century alt lost its second timings (alt is for screen readers). Acoustic Kitty short ends at the first white-out (no black bar on the page, so … not ▇▇▇); the sentence continues past the deletion, so this cut is at a deletion, not a clause end. Project 1794 short cuts after the list item 'ft.' (the sentence continues 'and a maximum range…'); quote writes 100,000 where the Varityper prints '100, 000'. Camp Century timing confirmed on both the source and the hosted 900 s clip (413 and 415 s frames identical).
